title: Evolution unlock day 12 on newer servers, Armigo morale buffs
summary: Every Palmon's evolution unlock now depends on server age in three bands, with servers 265 and up waiting until day 12, and the same server-265 band is added to recharge gifts, city UR monsters and mount package unlock days. Armigos level 5 to 10 gain a large morale increase, mounts get a new two-part sort order, and 23 new UI textures arrive for city summon packs, a new player frame and a season-two weekly reward.
highlights: Evolution unlock thresholds for all 39 Palmons: servers 1-240 from day 4, servers 241-264 from day 8, servers 265+ from day 12 (previously servers 241+ from day 8).
Armigo morale up for levels 5-10, player and NPC troops alike: Lvl 5 122 → 138, Lvl 6 130 → 180, Lvl 7 141 → 216, Lvl 8 155 → 238, Lvl 9 186 → 286, Lvl 10 224 → 345.
Mount sort order becomes a two-value ranking for Narfoal, Swiftger, Amourphibian, Slackycapy, Night Mare, Bunny Runny and Skybound Patrol.
Mount packages unlock on a server-age schedule (for example package 2 on day 3 for servers 1-264, day 60 for servers 265+); Ruins Challenge loses its open-condition day table.
Recharge gift hero pools and city UR monster spawns gain a fourth server band (servers 265-999).
DeathAddBuff4 now shows its super-evolve display flag.
23 new textures registered: city summon pack and use-item titles, city race heroes, player frame 027, milestone 113 and a season-two weekly task reward image.
